_about: Sea step 13e PEOPLE AND QUESTS (core/sea/sea_quest_rules.gd, game/sea_quests.gd; plan diary/DESIGN_REGION1.md 13e; LOCKED: each quest ends with its person moving to the home port and TAKING OVER A BUILDING from its placeholder resident; an own SEA QUEST LOG; progress is the HOST'S WORLD, shared by the party). quests: id, region, person (its words in data/sea/writing/quests_r1.txt [quest <id>]), at = where the person waits (sea x, z) until the quest is done, look = [outfit, gender, hair], takes_over = the town plot (data/sea/town.json residents) the person runs once done, steps in order: talk (talk to the person), bring {items} (talk to the person with them in the bag: they are taken), dive (a data/sea/salvage.json spot with "quest_item" + this quest + step: shown and taken only while the quest is at that step, its item into the bag), dungeon {dungeon, fight} (the host sees that dungeon fight cleared); a step's "at" is where its mark is drawn on the chart. talk_m = how near to talk.
